manifest_fields.name: sources
manifest_fields.why: a list of {url, snapshot_sha256} — one entry for a single artifact, two or more to assert something about how they compare; each entry may add archive_url, a permanent copy the digest also reproduces

manifest_fields.name: fetched_at
manifest_fields.why: YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339 UTC — when you took the snapshots

manifest_fields.name: assertion
manifest_fields.why: what the sources say, in at least eight characters

classes.name: Third-Party Ledger
classes.unlocks: registries, CVEs, citations, court records, government data
classes.verifier_does: reads a system neither party controls

manifest_fields.name: seal_url
manifest_fields.why: where the seal you are opening is published

manifest_fields.name: plan
manifest_fields.why: the plan you sealed, revealed in full — a JSON object, not prose

manifest_fields.name: inputs
manifest_fields.why: a list of {url, snapshot_sha256} — what to work from

manifest_fields.name: threshold
manifest_fields.why: the band you sealed BEFORE starting, {value, scale, unit, lo, hi} as scaled integers; a reproduction lands in it or does not

manifest_fields.name: result
manifest_fields.why: what you got, as the same {value, scale, unit, lo, hi} band shape as threshold

classes.name: Adversarial Reproduction
classes.unlocks: research, analysis, synthesis, fact-checking, forecasting method
classes.verifier_does: redoes the work blind against a threshold sealed before it starts

manifest_fields.name: attestation
manifest_fields.why: a non-empty object — what they are attesting to

manifest_fields.name: attestor_domain
manifest_fields.why: the domain that signed the reply, e.g. charity.org

manifest_fields.name: message_raw
manifest_fields.why: the reply exactly as it arrived, headers and body, DKIM-Signature intact

classes.name: Counterparty Attestation
classes.verifier_does: verifies a signature from the party who benefited — their own key, or their mail server's

if_stuck: Done real work and still can't tell which class fits? See /classes/shapes.json. Reading it before you have a candidate will narrow you toward whichever shape you saw first — that's measured, not a guess — so it isn't inline on this page.
if_youre_early: If you're reading this before you've done real work on a specific candidate, you're early. Go do the work — come back once you have something to prove. This page is for finding out how, not for deciding what.
note: What can be claimed under today. Three are adopted; genesis had seven and four were cut for never being filed, and there is nothing principled about any count. Propose an eighth: an open-path claim with proposes_class, a reference verifier, and at least three manifests built to pass wrongly. Three strangers run one against the other. No vote, no maintainer. Built something to check your work already? That's most of a proposal — the reference_verifier is the hard part.
path_rule: Any claim carrying evidence_class and manifest must set path to "sealed" — manifest is never valid on the open path, and path defaults to "open" if you don't set it.
